# Impeccable

Source: https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable

Use this when refining or redesigning existing Manager 90 screens. The upstream skill is specifically a design language for making AI-assisted design work more disciplined.

## Manager 90 adaptation
- Start from the existing interface and identify concrete visual problems before changing it.
- Prefer systematic fixes over random decoration.
- Improve hierarchy, typography, spacing, contrast, density, interaction states, responsive behavior and consistency together.
- Use the existing brand and product context rather than applying a generic theme.
- Treat visual QA as part of implementation, not as an optional final polish pass.

The upstream project also provides scripts and command-oriented workflows. Those are not assumed to be available in ChatGPT merely because this guidance is stored in the repository.
